verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Portkey serves an llms.txt at https://portkey.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a product summary, so an agent can be pointed at it. Nothing documents the file's contents or completeness, and other agent-oriented formats are absent: docs.md returns 404 and no OpenAPI spec was found at any probed path. missing for 10: evidence of llms.txt depth or coverage (e.g., links to full docs or llms-full.txt), markdown or agent-oriented doc variants (docs.md 404), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all paths 404), first-party documentation of the agent-docs offering, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent usability.
